messages:
IncidentBot: P1 alert — GPU pool 'inference-prod-us-west' at 100% util, autoscaler failing to add nodes. Queue length rising (> 12k). Paging oncall.
jordan: on it, grabbing metrics. link: https://grafana.redwood/company/inference-prod/gpu-queue (shortlink)
sara: seeing sustained enqueue rate ~800 req/s, tokens/sec spiking. autoscaler logs show repeated API 429 to cloud provider.
lee: also seeing a lot of driver restarts on node-gpu-.* in the last 15m. logs: `nvidia-driver: CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_INSTRUCTION (Xid 13)` and `oom-killer invoked`.
natalie: customer impact: three high-traffic tenants experiencing 503s; support has incoming tickets. tagging support.
support-bot: created ticket #INC-2029-423 for tenant alpha, #INC-2029-424 for tenant beta. adding status page note draft.
jordan: top priority: stabilize serving capacity. quick plan: (1) stop autoscaler up attempts to avoid churn (2) cordon flapping nodes (3) trigger fallback model routing to smaller models (4) drain heavy batchers.
lee: cordoning nodes now that show Xid errors: `kubectl cordon node-gpu-21` etc.
lee: running `kubectl get pods -o wide | grep gpu` to identify large-batch pods.
lee: command: 
```
kubectl cordon node-gpu-21 node-gpu-22 node-gpu-23
kubectl drain node-gpu-21 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force
```
jordan: autoscaler config shows cloud API 429 due to per-minute quota. infra-bot, can we open temporary quota with cloud provider or fallback to pre-warmed instances?
infra-bot: noted. Raised request with cloud-provider support case #CP-9876. ETA initial response ~15-30m. Meanwhile we have a small pool of reserved instances in us-west-2 that can be hot-swapped.
jordan: can we reassign reserved pool to inference-prod? if yes, we should attach immediately.
sara: I'm switching routing rules to move traffic from the largest models to quantized variants and to a lower-priority pool where possible. This should reduce GPU memory pressure.
lee: killing and restarting the driver on two nodes that have recurrent Xid 13. `systemctl restart nvidia-docker` applied. Observed one node recovered, one still emitting `OutOfMemoryError`.
natalie: support update: customers alpha/beta/gamma notified with internal status updates; SLA escalation for alpha. drafting postmortem notes.
jordan: temporary mitigation success: queue length down from 12k -> 6.5k after routing + cordon + reserved pool attach. still seeing intermittent 503s for long-tail requests.
lee: stack traces show `cuMemAlloc` failures before OOM kill. suspect kernel driver regression in the driver version rolled out ~2 days ago.
sara: can we rollback driver to previous stable on a small canary set to validate? If stable, roll forward.
jordan: agree. plan: (A) rollback driver on 3 canary nodes, (B) observe for 10m, (C) if stable, schedule rolling rollback for remaining nodes.
infra-bot: can perform driver rollback via the node image pipeline. rolling job queued `job/rollback-driver-1895`.
pagerduty: paging escalation to infra-sre oncall (natalie) since this is cloud quota + driver regression.
natalie: jumping in. I'll coordinate with cloud provider and infra. Assigning owners: infra-bot -> quota request, lee -> node-level diagnostics/rollback canary, sara -> routing & model fallbacks, jordan -> customer comms and incident lead.
support-bot: posting status page: "Investigating — GPU capacity exhaustion causing errors and increased latencies for inference endpoints." (ETA next update 15m)
jordan: observed one heavy batch job from internal experiments consuming a dozen GPUs despite low priority. Sara, can you disable internal batchers until capacity stabilizes?
sara: done. disabled batch-scheduler for experiments namespace.
lee: canary rollback started on node-gpu-45, GPU driver version v510 -> v495. logs: `driver loaded v495, no Xid observed in last 3m`.
jordan: good. schedule rolling rollback in waves of 5 nodes with 5m observation windows.
natalie: cloud provider acknowledged quota case; they increased instance launch rate for our account temporarily. should help autoscaler calls.
infra-bot: attaching reserved instance pool to inference-prod now. Confirmed 8 additional GPUs online.
jordan: queue now 3.1k and p95 latency improving. marking mitigation steps in runbook.
lee: noting for postmortem: probable root causes = driver regression causing OOM/Xid + autoscaler rate-limiting causing slow capacity growth; combined led to effective capacity drop and queue surge.
pagerduty: escalation note — oncall handoff scheduled in 2 hours. current severity P1.
natalie: handing off to oncall-jordan for next 2h. Jordan, please ack and include final checklist for next handoff.
jordan: acked. Handoff checklist in-case: (1) ensure rollback job completes for all flapping nodes, (2) confirm no further Xid logs for 20m, (3) keep reserved pool attached until autoscaler healthy, (4) customers updated, (5) create postmortem draft.
jordan: final update for this thread: immediate customer impact reduced, autoscaler ops restored, driver rollback in progress. leaving detailed logs & PR references in #eng-runtime.
IncidentBot: Incident P1 -> Mitigated. closed: temporary mitigations applied; postmortem required.
